name: Sunset: Future Shapers
detailed_description:
"Sunset: Future Shapers" is a free-to-play TPS, set in the elite training grounds where Earth’s best prepare for missions that are crucial for humanity’s future. As a recruit in the Earth Interplanetary Mission’s Academy, you’ll undertake simulated combat scenarios, resource management trials, and tactical exercises designed to forge the next generation of space explorers and defenders.

TRAIN LIKE A HERO

Engage in fast-paced combat, tactical missions, and survival simulations that test your skills in a simulated environment. Master different loadouts, adapt to unpredictable procedurally generated scenarios, and prove your rank as a top cadet.

A DYNAMIC SHOOTING EXPERIENCE

Shooting, mining, and all the major gameplay dynamics will be available thanks to your solar powered backpack. Remember to charge it any chance you get or you’d better find somewhere to hide!

All the relevant information will be displayed through diegetic objects, no HUD will ruin your immersion in the game.

YOUR PATH, YOUR RANK

Your performance in each simulation determines your standing in the Academy Leaderboard. Rise through the ranks to earn exclusive skins, emblems, and early access to advanced gear. Will you be the top cadet by graduation?

ARE YOU READY FOR YOUR NEXT CHALLENGE?

"Sunset: Future Shapers" isn’t for the faint of heart, it’s a trial by fire for hardcore gamers. Master labyrinthine simulations, conquer the hardest fights and push your combat skills to their absolute limits. Skill, strategy, and persistence will be rewarded. Do you have what it takes?

PREPARE FOR THE FUTURE

"Future Shapers" sets the stage for "Sunset: Broken Embers", introducing key factions, technologies, and conflicts that will shape your journey beyond the academy’s walls.

CREATED WITH UNREAL® ENGINE 5

"Sunset: Future Shapers" is being created using Unreal® Engine 5 to deliver the best interactive experience possible.
